preconditions.description: The number of engineers N must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= current <= 2 * N and 1 <= desired <= 2 * N for current, desired in zip(current_desks, desired_desks))
preconditions.description: Each engineer's current and desired desk numbers must be between 1 and 2N.
No two engineers can currently sit at the same desk.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of possible seating arrangements modulo 1000000007.
